scenario.title: Test: Basic Land Starting Hand Verification
scenario.description: Verify that ScenarioLibrarySetup correctly places the specified cards at the front of each player's library so they are drawn as the opening hand.
scenario.question: Does P1 start with exactly 3 Mountains, 2 Forests, 1 Island, and 1 Plains?
scenario.answer: Yes — the library reorder places these 7 cards at the front before drawCards() is called.
